title: Renters' Rights Act 2025 (Inglaterra) (1/4)
Renters' Rights Act 2025 (England) (1/4)
text: Desde el 1 de mayo de 2026, en Inglaterra los alquileres «assured» pasaron a ser indefinidos (rolling), sin fecha de fin: Tú puedes irte avisando con un máximo de 2 meses de antelación, por escrito.
Since 1 May 2026, «assured» tenancies in England have become open-ended (rolling), with no end date: you can leave by giving at most 2 months' notice in writing.

title: Renters' Rights Act 2025 (Inglaterra) (2/4)
Renters' Rights Act 2025 (England) (2/4)
text: El casero solo puede echarte con un motivo válido y un aviso «section 8». El alquiler solo puede subir una vez al año, nunca en el primer año, con 2 meses de aviso.
The landlord can only evict you with a valid reason and a «section 8» notice. Rent can only go up once a year, never in the first year, with 2 months' notice.

title: Renters' Rights Act 2025 (Inglaterra) (3/4)
Renters' Rights Act 2025 (England) (3/4)
text: No se permite pujar por encima del precio anunciado ni pedir alquiler por adelantado antes de firmar. Señal de reserva: como máximo una semana de alquiler. Fianza: como máximo 5 semanas (si el alquiler anual es menor de £50.000), protegida en un plan oficial.

Bidding above the advertised price and asking for rent in advance before signing are not allowed. Holding deposit: at most one week's rent. Deposit: at most 5 weeks (if the annual rent is under £50,000), protected in an official scheme.

The landlord cannot refuse a pet without a reasonable reason. Note: these rules do not apply if you live with the landlord in their home (as a lodger).

The first £12,570 a year is tax-free (the Personal Allowance). From £12,571 to £50,270 you pay 20%; from £50,271 to £125,140, 40%; above that, 45% (the bands are different in Scotland).

The United Kingdom combines Acts of Parliament (Statute Law), judge-made law (Common Law) and constitutional conventions (e.g. the Prime Minister must have the confidence of the House of Commons).

title: Devolución asimétrica: Escocia, Gales e Irlanda del Norte
Asymmetric devolution: Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland
Competencias transferidas vs materias reservadas en el Reino Unido (1/2)
Devolved powers vs reserved matters in the United Kingdom (1/2)
text: Objetivo: distinguir qué decide Westminster para todo el Reino Unido y qué gestionan el Parlamento Escocés (Holyrood), el Senedd galés y la Asamblea de Irlanda del Norte (Stormont).
Goal: tell what Westminster decides for the whole United Kingdom from what the Scottish Parliament (Holyrood), the Welsh Senedd and the Northern Ireland Assembly (Stormont) manage.

title: Competencias transferidas vs materias reservadas en el Reino Unido (2/2)
Devolved powers vs reserved matters in the United Kingdom (2/2)
text: Materias habitualmente transferidas (devolved): sanidad cotidiana, educación y administración local (por eso prescripciones o tasas universitarias pueden variar entre Inglaterra y Escocia). Materias reservadas al Parlamento del Reino Unido: defensa, política exterior e inmigración/nacionalidad.

Usually devolved matters: day-to-day health care, education and local government (which is why prescriptions or university fees can differ between England and Scotland). Matters reserved to the UK Parliament: defence, foreign policy and immigration/nationality.
